issue.title: Show a POST-closeout review summary toast from that day's bob stats
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-6l.6 (note #2); suggested in plan:202610/daily_stats.md rollout phase.

When the #gtd #post Morning review checklist row is completed during the ]s walk (bob-navigation-hotkeys 535-plugin-review-checklist-walk.js completeReviewChecklistRow), show one summary toast such as "Review closed · 41 answered · 1h 40m · keep 82%" built from that day's `bob stats` report via bob-ledger-tools api.stats.fetch (v2) — reviewed, review_time, and keep_rate for today. It must never block or fail the checklist answer; when bob or the report is unavailable it shows nothing. Values and display strings come from bob (no JS mirror of metric semantics).

task_type_fields.proposal: When the #gtd #post Morning review row completes in the ]s walk, show one toast like 'Review closed · 41 answered · 1h 40m · keep 82%' from today's bob stats report.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The Daily Stats plan's rollout phase recorded this as a follow-up; v1 keeps Stats a weekly instrument with no daily-surface additions.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-6l.6 proposed a one-line review summary when the Morning review closes, built from bob stats; it was suggested by the Daily Stats plan but not part of v1.
